subject: social_studies
concept: Conducting a simple social observation: noticing and recording real social behaviors in a described setting
source_inspiration: adapted from basic social-science observation methodology — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes a real or described social setting and records specific behaviors noticed, without assuming reasons behind them
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts observations into 'what I actually saw' versus 'what I'm guessing about why'
exercise.abstract: Student writes an observation-based note distinguishing factual observation from interpretation

misconception_flags: records an assumption or guess as if it were a directly observed fact

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
